facts.text: The hotel is on Kongens Nytorv, in the heart of Copenhagen.
facts.excerpt: is located in the very heart of Copenhagen - on the city's most prominent square, Kongens Nytorv

facts.text: The nearest metro stop, Kongens Nytorv, is steps from the hotel entrance, and the metro runs directly to Copenhagen Airport in about 15 minutes.
facts.excerpt: The metro runs directly to Copenhagen Airport in approximately 15 minutes. The metro stop nearest the hotel is called Kongens Nytorv and is only steps away from the hotel entrance.

facts.text: Amalienborg Castle, The Marble Church, Christiansborg, Tivoli Gardens and Strøget can be reached on foot.
facts.excerpt: many attractions can be reached on foot – for example Amalienborg Castle, The Marble Church, Christiansborg, Tivoli Gardens and pedestrian shopping street Strøget.

facts.text: The hotel's history dates to 1755, when Jean Marchal and Maria Coppy founded a restaurant that later turned into a luxury hotel.
facts.excerpt: In 1755 the French servant Jean Marchal married the royal chef's daughter Maria Coppy and they founded a restaurant that later turned into a luxury hotel.

facts.text: The name Hotel d'Angleterre, French for The England Hotel, came from The English Club hosted by owner Gottfried Rau.
facts.excerpt: he renamed the building Hotel d’Angleterre, French for The England Hotel.

facts.text: In 2001 the glass artist Albano Poli gave the Palm Court a mosaic roof, described by the hotel as the biggest mosaic roof in Northern Europe.
facts.excerpt: More than hundred thousand brightly colored glass mosaics and 30 tons of materials were transported to Denmark to make the biggest mosaic roof in Northern Europe.

facts.text: Alfred Hitchcock's film Torn Curtain was filmed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Alfred Hitchcock's movie "Torn Curtain" was filmed at d'Angleterre.

facts.text: Since Christmas 1995, thousands of small lights blanket the front of the hotel each Christmas.
facts.excerpt: Christmas of 1995 marked the beginning of a new tradition in the history of d’Angleterre. Thousands of small lights were installed to blanket the front of the hotel

facts.text: The hotel has an original Andy Warhol.
facts.excerpt: Experience our original Andy Warhol.

facts.text: The hotel has artwork by Spanish artist Joan Miró.
facts.excerpt: Experience our artwork by Spanish artist Joan Miró.

facts.text: The building balances stately Victorian architecture and contemporary Nordic design.
facts.excerpt: balancing stately Victorian architecture and contemporary Nordic design

facts.text: Marchal is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant, pairing Nordic cuisine with French flair.
facts.excerpt: Nordic cuisine meets French flair in our Michelin-starred restaurant.

facts.text: When the weather allows, Marchal extends onto the terrace and sidewalk of Kongens Nytorv.
facts.excerpt: When the weather allows, Marchal extends onto the terrace and sidewalk of Kongens Nytorv

facts.text: Balthazar Champagne Bar offers more than 200 Champagnes, caviar service and live DJs on weekends.
facts.excerpt: the bar offers a selection of more than 200 Champagnes, tapas-style dishes, caviar service, and live DJs on weekends

facts.text: Maison, the hotel's patisserie and delicacy shop, opened in December 2021.
facts.excerpt: Maison, the whimsical patisserie and delicacy shop, opened in December 2021

facts.text: Krug Afternoon Tea is served on Sundays, and reservation is required online.
facts.excerpt: Krug Afternoon Tea is served on Sundays from 3pm to 5pm, except selected dates. Reservation is required and can only be made online.

facts.text: Breakfast is served in Marchal with a view over Kongens Nytorv.
facts.excerpt: breakfast is served in Marchal restaurant with a spectacular view over Kongens Nytorv

facts.text: The hotel has a private pool and spa managed by the holistic spa and skincare concept Amazing Space.
facts.excerpt: a private pool and spa managed by the world-renowned holistic spa & skincare concept Amazing Space

facts.text: Not all rooms have balconies.
facts.excerpt: Please note that not all rooms have balconies.

facts.text: A number of rooms and suites feature private balconies with views of Kongens Nytorv or central Copenhagen.
facts.excerpt: A number of our luxury rooms and suites at d’Angleterre feature private balconies with views of Kongens Nytorv or central Copenhagen

facts.text: Room service is available around the clock.
facts.excerpt: room service is available at d’Angleterre around the clock

facts.text: The hotel offers baby and children amenities such as a baby cot, high chair, baby bathtub and toys, on advance request.
facts.excerpt: we offer a wide selection of baby and children amenities at the hotel, for example a baby cot, high chair, baby bathtub, potty, changing mat, toys, and much more. Please let us know in advance

facts.text: Dogs weighing up to 10 kg are welcome.
facts.excerpt: We are delighted to extend a warm welcome to dogs weighing up to 10 kg.

facts.text: Dogs are not allowed in Marchal, the bar area or Balthazar Champagne Bar, but are welcome in the Upper Lobby.
facts.excerpt: Kindly note that dogs are not allowed in Marchal, our bar area, or Balthazar Champagne Bar, but are welcome in the Upper Lobby.

facts.text: The hotel is fully wheelchair accessible, with elevators to all floors.
facts.excerpt: d’Angleterre is a fully wheelchair accessible hotel in Copenhagen. The hotel consists of accessible rooms and public areas, and elevators run to all floors of the building.

facts.text: The concierge team can plan a family visit to LEGOLAND Billund.
facts.excerpt: Let our Concierge Team plan an unforgettable visit to LEGOLAND Billund for you and your family.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange a private tour of the city's royal castles.
facts.excerpt: elevate your experience with a private tour arranged by our concierge team

facts.text: A LEGO model of the hotel is on display in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: Step into the lobby and discover a playful surprise - a meticulously crafted LEGO model of our iconic hotel.

facts.text: The hotel was awarded Two MICHELIN Keys in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide selection.
facts.excerpt: We are proud to announce that we have been awarded Two MICHELIN Keys, remaining the only hotel in Denmark recognised with more than one key in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide selection.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the most beautiful hotel in Denmark.
facts.excerpt: The most beautiful hotel in Denmark has more to offer than surface charms.
